content_data.project_title: Regional Telecommunications Service Enhancement & Upsell Program
content_data.project_description: A focused initiative to enhance customer experience and drive strategic upsells within our regional telecommunications market segments, leveraging new service bundles.
content_data.timeline: 6 months, with a 3-month pilot phase followed by a 3-month scaling phase
objectives: Successfully launch and integrate two new service bundles within the pilot region
Increase ARPU (Average Revenue Per User) by 10% within the target regional segments
deliverables: New service bundle descriptions and pricing models
Customer communication strategy and materials for launch
Monthly performance reports including ARPU, retention, and upsell conversion rates
Post-pilot customer feedback summary and recommendations
content_data.market_analysis: Recent studies indicate a strong appetite for bundled services among mid-sized customers in our regional footprint, particularly those offering enhanced connectivity and value-added digital services.
revenue_targets: Achieve an additional $50,000 in monthly recurring revenue (MRR) by the end of the pilot phase
